about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/fix (ergo fix, EXPLICIT EX1): edits that TestFixProperty or TestExplicitClauseText must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants internal/sketch/fix.

mutants.name: ex1-needs-for-fails
mutants.rule: A failure is written in the fails clause, a capability in needs.

mutants.name: ex1-no-recheck
mutants.rule: Writing a callee's clause can make its callers exceed theirs: the tool checks again until no clause diagnostic is left.

mutants.name: ex1-after-takes
mutants.rule: A new clause goes after the results and fails, before takes (grammar.md Declarations).

mutants.name: ex1-no-import
mutants.rule: An element of a package the file does not import is written with the import it needs.

mutants.name: ex1-reorder-written
mutants.rule: Written elements keep their written order; the missing ones follow them.

mutants.name: ex1-site-row-text
mutants.rule: Every site of one clause prints the whole clause, one text.

mutants.name: ex2-no-open
mutants.rule: A clause written after a lone result of function type is the function's only when the result is in parentheses; otherwise it is the result type's row.

mutants.name: rel4-spell-targs
mutants.rule: ergo fix spells every form of a capability's argument, so it writes every clause the checker asks for (q137).

mutants.name: rel4-spell-second-import
mutants.rule: ergo fix spells every form of a capability's argument, so it writes every clause the checker asks for (q137).

mutants.name: rel5-hide-named
mutants.rule: A clause that must name a prelude type the package hides is not written (fix would name the package's type); the S102 asks for the rename (L6, q30).

mutants.name: rel5-hide-basic
mutants.rule: A universe basic type the package hides has no spelling there.

mutants.name: rel5-hide-map
mutants.from: s.hide("Map") // the syntax's Map[K, V] (grammar.md, Parser 8)
mutants.rule: The map type has no spelling in a package that declares its own Map.

mutants.name: rel5-hide-attach
mutants.rule: The checker never attaches a clause it cannot write (q137): the S102 that asks for the rename carries none.
